shots.content: Inside a dining room, a rectangular table stands between a sideboard and patio doors, with a window along one side. A man in a blue shirt sits at the sideboard-side window seat and asks about preferred tea options, while a woman in a yellow shirt sits at the patio-side window seat and a man in a purple shirt sits at the sideboard-end seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the patio-door end, looking lengthwise along the dining table toward the sideboard, with both window-side seats and the sideboard-end seat in frame.

shots.content: The man in a blue shirt and the woman in a yellow shirt swap the sideboard-side window seat and the patio-side window seat, and she answers that sugar is requested.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: The man in a blue shirt replies that only lemon will be served.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot from the sideboard end, looking lengthwise along the dining table toward the patio doors, with both window-side seats and the sideboard-end seat in frame.
